name: markdown-parser-bench
description: Benchmarks and evidence scripts for docs/rewrite (02-benchmarks, 08-model-and-api, phase-1/decisions P1-1). Not part of the published package.

scripts.model:memory: for m in mdast tokens tree table; do node --expose-gc model.mjs 60 $m; done
scripts.autolink:fetch: mkdir -p spec && curl -sSfL -o spec/spec.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/cmark-gfm/master/test/spec.txt && curl -sSfL -o spec/extensions.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/cmark-gfm/master/test/extensions.txt
